name: DMD 2300
title: 3D Animation I
description: Introduction to 3D Animation techniques including key framing, curve editing, timing, squash and stretch, walk cycles, and the 12 principles of animation.
requirement_description: DMD 1001 and 1101; open only to Digital Media and Design majors; others by instructor consent. Corequisite: DMD 1002 and 1102.
